Underserved communities, like Uvalde, are in desperate need of access to mental health treatment.
 
That is why I am proud to support the Restoring Hope for Mental Health & Well-Being Act that will commit significant resources to mental health awareness, training, and treatment. https://t.co/31oQi6RdGx

China has surrounded Taiwan & called it an exercise. Their actions demonstrate how far they will go to instill fear upon their neighbors. The US must act accordingly to prevent their behavior from becoming the new norm & uphold the intl rule of law. https://t.co/jlOBAbFhzG

I had a meeting with Maverick County’s hospital district leadership staff. I helped them secure $500K to improve treatment and education for diabetes patients in the area in Congress. I look forward to seeing these funds in action. https://t.co/8W7QkmDnHo

$37.6M for Project Advancing Wellness and Resiliency in Education (AWARE):

-Infrastructure for mental health programs in schools.
-Promotion of healthy social & emotional development.
-Youth violence prevention.

The deadline to apply is October 13, 2022.

More than 6 million Americans are living with Alzheimer’s. Join me in raising awareness for all those who are suffering while we continue to support research advancements and treatment efforts. https://t.co/d6dZ0FdLPN

Everyone faces negative feelings sometimes, but when these persist it may be a sign that it’s time to get help. That’s why during #MentalIllnessAwarenessWeek, it's important that we learn to recognize common warning signs that someone may be struggling.
https://t.co/NPFddcbZIG

During #HispanicHeritageMonth, I am proud to recognize Rachel Gonzales-Hanson who is serving as the Interim President of @NACHC where she is working to advance key priority areas centered around patients' needs. Thank you to Rachel for always advocating to put patients first! https://t.co/wyVVVHBI2W

Across the world, more than half a billion people are living with diabetes. Today on #WorldDiabetesDay join me in raising awareness for those who are suffering as we continue to support research advancements and treatment options. https://t.co/cqAeXA5UDn

November is Alzheimer’s Awareness Month. Join me in raising awareness for patients and their families as we continue in our treatment and research efforts to fight this disease. https://t.co/FsLnqUgkgv

Today I had the opportunity to meet with leaders from @umcelpaso. We discussed the importance of healthcare workers and their role in providing essential resources to hospitals caring for our nation’s most vulnerable populations. https://t.co/RzpYdBQr3e

January is Cervical Health Awareness Month. Each year, over 14,000 women in the US are diagnosed with invasive cervical cancer. Join me in raising awareness for patients and their families as we continue the fight against this disease. https://t.co/S0LcND0JeX

1.9 million new cancer cases will be diagnosed this year. During National Cancer Prevention Month, join me in raising awareness for symptoms and warning signs as we continue our research to #FightCancer. https://t.co/tnboCgzbyg

Women are the backbone of our households & our communities. They see firsthand the struggles their students, patients, husbands & sons are facing on the front lines in Del Rio. https://t.co/K1b1jVr4Xm

Today, @HomelandGOP passed my amendments to ensure @DHS considers access to external resources such as service animals for treatment of mental health, & Border Patrol Agents & other federal law enforcement personnel are not punished for coming forward with a mental health issue. https://t.co/iuLpNa26Rl

Just visited with Fort Duncan Regional Medical Center’s CEO, Eladio Montalvo.

This is the untold story of the border crisis. Local hospitals foot the bill for migrant medical care and often don’t see a penny in reimbursements. https://t.co/W6N5bat98U

Congrats to Samuel Zhao from San Antonio for being selected as this year’s Congressional App Challenge winner for #TX23. His app “Hola Dental” seeks to improve access to dental care for Spanish-speaking patients.

Many servicemembers and veterans proudly call #TX23 home. Today, I met with @SecVetAffairs  alongside @BipartisanVets. 

We are committed to ensuring our troops, their families, and all those who served have access to quality healthcare and their hard-earned benefits. Great discussion today. 🇺🇸

Many Americans are being affected by a loss of cell coverage today. 

This is just a taste of what it could be like if one of our adversaries launches a cyber attack against us. 

My National Digital Reserve Corps Act would equip our government with a proven pipeline of cybersecurity experts. No better time to get this signed into law!
Great to touch base with the Ysleta del Sur Pueblo Health Director this morning to discuss Tribal healthcare initiatives. Always good to be with the Pueblo! #TX23 https://t.co/xkN4xovzA9

Great to meet with outstanding leaders in the Army Medical Department Medical Service Corps in my D.C. office this week. Thank you for your work in improving healthcare and medical services for our veterans, servicemembers, and military families. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/ats6D2xTSP

I served our country for 20 years in the U.S. Navy. As veterans, we step up to the plate for each other—it’s engrained in who we are. 

I helped secure funding for a new VA facility that will serve over 54,000 veterans in El Paso & West Texas. ⬇️

https://t.co/gjgG1K4jCq

I voted YES on @HouseAppropsGOP’s Military Construction & VA bill which passed the House today & contains several key wins for #TX23. Our legislation FULLY protects VA healthcare benefits and will improve quality of life for our troops and military families.

I enjoyed meeting with some of #TX23’s healthcare heroes this afternoon at PAM Health’s Long-Term Acute Care Facility in San Antonio. 

Thank you for hosting me today. https://t.co/0aGL6n1xpY

.@HomelandGOP ➡️ House Floor

Pearl is a loyal therapy canine to our Border Patrol Agents. 

With the committee's passage of the PEARL Act, we’re one step closer to getting more canine companions to support mental health initiatives for our CBP personnel. 🐾 https://t.co/4Oeag2SE1f

📍Uvalde

Today marks an important milestone for mental health access in Texas with the groundbreaking of a NEW Regional Behavioral Health Campus in Uvalde. 

This project has been several years in the making, and I’m proud to have delivered $2 million in federal funds to help with construction for this facility, which will service 32 counties in rural Texas. #UvaldeUnited
